properties.description: Actual exterior-square/Hodge multiplicative equivalence with PSU4(q), in every characteristic
Uniform projective order for every n>=2 over finite fields
Nonexceptional simplicity for every n>=2 over finite fields
Noncommutativity for every n>=2 over finite fields
Actual elementary group perfect for every n>=2
Actual projective exterior-action kernel is exactly the SU4 center
Actual SU4 exterior action surjects onto the elementary minus group

exceptions: No simplicity exceptions for n>=2 over finite fields. Rank2 is structurally PSL2(K); rank3 is structurally PSU4(q). Stable principal roles retain n>=4; separately audited uniform order and simplicity supplements cover every n>=2.
